text:
Maya (CS): kicking off SolsticeAI dedicated bring-up thread — they want a predictable 99th pct latency for chat + embeddings, planning quota and autoscale now. timeline: customer-facing warmup next Wed.
Arjun (SRE): quick numbers: their expected steady qps ~450 req/min, spikes up to 1.8k/min during campaigns. with our default pool and batching that maps to ~12 sustained GPUs, 18 peak for safe headroom.
Tess (EngInfra): noted. do we have an autoscale policy draft for them? suggest: scale_up when 95th_token_latency > 120ms for 3m, scale_down after 10m idle.
Maya (CS): that policy looks reasonable. customer asked for warmup sequence that primes KV caches and prefix cache. can we schedule a deterministic warmup script?
Arjun (SRE): yes — simplest is a 2-stage soak: (1) prefix replay for top-1000 prompts @ 5 qps for 2h, (2) synthetic chat traffic ramp 0->peak over 30m, hold 1h. also run an embedding batch of 100k vectors to exercise mem.
Tess (EngInfra): adding autoscale JSON draft:
```
{"scale_up_condition": "p90_latency>120ms for 180s","min_instances": 12,"max_instances": 24,"cooldown_down": 600}
```
use this as starting point. tweak after smoke.
Sam (Acct PM): FYI — customer renewal is in 10 months. if warmup shows persistent latency spikes we'll flag as a risk in QBR. please capture metrics + postmortem if anything odd.
Maya (CS): will do. also need enablement session for their ops team on readbacks/rollbacks. can someone draft a 30-min runbook walk?
Arjun (SRE): I can run the runbook demo. need a run of the actual traffic beforehand. schedule the demo the day after the soak.
Maya (CS): noted. Solstice point-of-contact is @kevin.solstice (ops). I'll lock calendar once we confirm soak window.
Tess (EngInfra): one more ops detail — recommend enabling prefix caching and 4-hour K/V cache retention for this account. reduces cold-start token cost.
Maya (CS): I'll propose that to the customer.
Sam (Acct PM): also capture any feature requests during onboarding — if they want dedicated model variant pinning that's a potential add-on sale.
Maya (CS): good call. I'll include in feedback capture template.
CI Bot: loadtest job queued: job_id=ci-78901, spec=solstice-soak-v1, start=2028-04-18T09:00Z
Arjun (SRE): thanks bot. once it completes, please paste the raw p99/p95/p50 token latencies and GPU util traces here. small script to grab traces:
```
./fetch_traces --job ci-78901 --metrics p50,p95,p99,gpu_util > solstice-trace.tar.gz
```
Maya (CS): schedule check-in: soak Wed 09:00 UTC; demo Thurs 11:00 UTC; postmortem Fri 16:00 UTC. can everyone confirm?
Tess (EngInfra): confirmed.
Arjun (SRE): confirmed.
Sam (Acct PM): confirmed.
Maya (CS): action items: 1) Arjun run soak + paste traces (action by Wed EOD UTC). 2) Tess finalize autoscale JSON and enable prefix caching. 3) Sam capture renewal flags and feature ask. 4) Maya run enablement and gather feedback.
Maya (CS): small risk note: if p99 > 300ms during soak we escalate to dedicated capacity increase; that would change cost/contract — flagging for negotiation. :warning:
Sam (Acct PM): copying legal and finance on that contingency after soak.
Maya (CS): thanks team — will update thread with job outputs and customer feedback. :thumbsup:
